verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a public Khoj API that a user or agent could call programmatically. The API mentions are about consuming third-party LLM APIs (Ollama's OpenAI-compatible server, LiteLLM, provider API keys), which does not transfer to this story. Probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. The Emacs, Obsidian and desktop clients imply a server, but no documented public API surface is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
